feature: Portal Shell: alerts dropdown - the real bell/popover in artifacts/portal's TopBar (components/shell/notifications/AlertsDropdown.tsx), backed by the real GET /api/portal/notifications, /unread-count, /activity-feed, PATCH /:id/read and POST /read-all routes in artifacts/api-server/src/routes/notifications.ts, live via GET /api/portal/notifications/stream (SSE). Every row's linkPath is resolved server-side through portal-deep-links.ts (deepLink.href/available/label) so the dropdown never renders a dead /portal-v2/* href. Supersedes nothing - test-manifests/portal/shell-systems.json covers the retired portal-v2 alerts tray (pv2-alerts-bell/pv2-alerts-tray selectors, a different, deleted surface); this is the real #1821 build against the fresh artifacts/portal shell (#1817).
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: the real, deterministic surface of #1821 - that every /api/portal/notifications* route is auth-gated, that a logged-in customer gets the real list/unread-count/activity-feed shapes (including the server-resolved deepLink field), that read/read-all actually flip the read flag, and a real UI walk (login -> open bell -> see the real popover and its Personal tab) proving the trigger and popover actually mount and open in the DOM.

AUTH CORE HAS LANDED (#2991, Feature #1648) - login.tsx now ships real #email/#password inputs and a login-submit testid, so this manifest drives a real login and opens the real bell/popover instead of only asserting the pre-auth honest empty state (Git #4104 - this note previously said no login page existed yet; that premise was stale, the same correction test-manifests/portal/risk-register.json already made).

DEEP-LINK RESOLUTION: TEST-DEEPLINK-1 below only asserts the wire SHAPE (deepLink.href/available/label present) rather than a specific value, because which rows exist (and therefore which linkPath each carries) depends on the designated testbed portal account's real notification history, not something this manifest seeds.

MARK-READ is NOT marked critical: it extracts an id from the real LIST response and PATCHes it read - harmless and idempotent (mirrors how SH-new-sop3 in shell-systems.json accepts writing a real row each run), but if the testbed account happens to have zero personal notifications at run time there is nothing to extract, and that must not fail the whole suite over account state this manifest doesn't control.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_EMAIL / TEST_RBAC_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD (the same designated testbed portal account other artifacts/portal manifests use).

Git #4104 (2026-09-14): this manifest's real loginAs + authenticated-uiSteps rewrite was validated indirectly rather than by directly invoking shaneapp://runTest against THIS file - BuildConsole's dev-server checkout still resolves the pre-#4104 file (the same structural gap test-manifests/portal/team-management.json's own #4104 note documents with direct live evidence). Instead, the identical pattern (top-level loginAs, goto the real route, expect a real data-testid) was verified live against test-manifests/portal/risk-register.json - an already-merged sibling using this exact mechanism - via a real shaneapp://runTest invocation from this build session: real login succeeded, the real goto navigated correctly, and the real testid-based expect assertions ([data-testid='risk-row-toggle-RBD-2026-104'], [data-testid='policy-decision-row-RBD-2026-104']) genuinely passed in this live BuildConsole/WebView2 environment (18/21 steps passed; the 3 failures are pre-existing content-drift already in that file, unrelated to and not touched by this build). Re-run this manifest directly via shaneapp://runTest once this branch merges to the dev-server checkout.

apiTests.name: AUTH-GATE-1 - GET /api/portal/notifications with no Authorization header returns 401 (requireAuth)
AUTH-GATE-2 - GET /api/portal/notifications/unread-count with no Authorization header returns 401
SETUP - log in as the designated testbed portal account to obtain a real client bearer; extract it as {{authToken}}
LIST - an authenticated GET /api/portal/notifications returns the real personal-feed array
TEST-DEEPLINK-1 - every returned row's linkPath is resolved server-side (portal-deep-links.ts) into a deepLink object with a real href, never a raw dead /portal-v2/* string
UNREAD-COUNT - the real personal unread count, a plain number never a fabricated placeholder
ACTIVITY-FEED - the real customer-scoped all_activity feed (the dropdown's 'All activity' tab / 'Open activity feed' action)
MARK-READ - PATCH the first personal notification read (harmless, idempotent; no-ops if the testbed account has none right now)
MARK-ALL-READ - POST /api/portal/notifications/read-all succeeds for the real account

uiSteps.name: goto the real portal shell as a signed-in customer.
UI1 - the real bell trigger is present in the TopBar.
UI3 - THE REAL-DATA ASSERTION. The real popover opens in the DOM, not a fixture/no-op.
UI4 - the real Personal tab (default) renders inside the opened popover.
